title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
summary: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.
reason: Item is a lighthearted PR comment about Gmail reliability during tech outages. No model release, research artifact, business event (financing/M&A/partnership/market data), policy action, or open-source tooling; no rule covers it.
